title: Deep learning for protein structure prediction

query.L1: How can representation learning improve scientific reasoning about protein structure?
query.L2: How can neural sequence representations connect evolutionary signals with molecular mechanisms?
query.L3: How can graph neural networks integrate residue contacts, conformational uncertainty, and experimental constraints into a testable protein design workflow?

title: Bayesian optimization for autonomous materials discovery

query.L1: How can active learning accelerate cross-disciplinary materials discovery?
